career.en: At work, scattered brainstorming narrows into an actionable plan. Drop vanity projects and focus your resources on the single path with real traction.
career.zh: 在工作上，发散的构想正收束为可执行的计划。砍掉虚浮的面子工程，把资源集中到真正能跑通的那条路径上。

health.en: Clarity returns around what actually supports your wellbeing; trade escapist habits for one simple, realistic daily routine.
health.zh: 你开始清楚什么才真正有益于身心；放下逃避式的消耗习惯，换上一个简单却能长期落实的日常节奏。

spirituality.en: Grounded discernment replaces spiritual daydreaming; quiet daily practice now matters far more than chasing dramatic signs.
spirituality.zh: 踏实的辨识力取代了悬浮的灵性幻想；眼下平实稳定的日常修习，远比追逐戏剧化的神秘讯号更有力量。

promptSpec.suitAccent: luminous cerulean-sapphire, moonstone amethyst, shimmering pearl highlights, gleaming gilded chalices, moonlit ivory
promptSpec.scene: In the lower foreground, ONE dark silhouetted Belle Epoque figure in a midnight-indigo cloak stands seen from behind with one hand slightly raised in wonder, gazing upward into a billowing expanse of moonlit cerulean and amethyst-silver clouds. Floating cleanly across the luminous clouds in two tidy, unmistakable arched rows (four on the upper arc, three on the lower arc) are EXACTLY SEVEN gleaming antique-gold chalices. Rising softly from each of the seven cups is a crisp, glowing miniature vision: a tiny golden castle, sparkling jewels, an emerald laurel wreath, a small crimson-gold dragon, a radiant veiled spirit, a coiled silver serpent, and a serene ivory bust. Bright moonlight and molten-gold highlights make all seven chalices and their seven visions pop crisply against the velvety midnight-indigo sky.

requiredObjects.object: ornate golden chalices floating in clouds with miniature visions
silhouetted dreamer gazing upward

promptSpec.compositionNote: Dark lower silhouette anchoring the bottom third while EXACTLY SEVEN bright golden chalices glow in a clean 4-over-3 cloud arc across the upper two-thirds—count and dreamlike silhouette read cleanly at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Courageous departure from what is merely enough—walking into the night in search of deeper meaning.
archetypeEssence.zh: 主动离开“尚算体面却已不再滋养”的旧局——迎着夜色动身，去寻更深层的意义。

en: Cloaked traveler with a wooden walking staff turning away toward steep moonlit mountains
Eight stacked golden cups left standing in the foreground with a noticeable missing gap
Waning crescent and shadowed lunar eclipse glowing overhead in a quiet night sky
Tidal stream and rocky trail marking the deliberate crossing into unfamiliar terrain
zh: 手持木杖、披着旅袍转身走向月色群山的远行者
前景中整齐码放却留出一处空缺的八只金色圣杯
夜空中半明半暗的月蚀弯月，映照深层内在觉醒
溪流与蜿蜒山径，象征清醒跨入未知旅程

en: Solitary Belle Epoque traveler in a deep plum-and-indigo cloak holding a slender gilded staff, striding away toward moonlit sapphire peaks
Exactly eight gleaming antique-gold chalices neatly stacked in the lower foreground—five along the base and three on top with one unmistakable empty gap
Luminous pale ivory crescent-and-eclipse moon glowing softly in a velvety midnight-indigo sky
Shimmering cerulean tidal creek and rocky mountain path separating the left-behind cups from the rising horizon
zh: 身披深紫蓝旅袍、手执纤细鎏金木杖走向月色群峰的美好年代行者
前景石阶上清晰可数的八只古金圣杯——下排五只、上排三只，留出一处醒目空缺
深邃午夜靛蓝天幕中微明静谧的月白月蚀之月
微光泛蓝的潮汐溪水与蜿蜒山路，将身后旧杯与远方高地清晰分隔

core.en: Eight of Cups is the quiet honesty of outgrowing something that still looks fine from the outside. Nothing exploded—yet your heart knows a deeper truth is waiting uphill, and staying would only shrink you.
core.zh: 圣杯八代表一种安静却坚定的清醒：外人眼里一切尚算体面，甚至没有爆发激烈冲突，但你心里清楚这一章已经盛不下你的成长，继续留着只会慢慢消耗自己。

message.en: Honor the quiet nudge to move on—leaving what no longer fulfills you is an act of self-respect, not failure.
message.zh: 尊重内心那股想动身的安静直觉——离开不再滋养你的处境，是清醒自爱，绝非半途而废。

foundation.en: You invested sincerely and built something real, only to realize over time that a vital piece is still missing.
foundation.zh: 你曾认真投入并搭建出一番成果，却在日积月累中发现，心里最在乎的那一块始终空着。

present.en: You are standing at the threshold of departure; the cups behind you are orderly, yet your compass already points toward the hills.
present.zh: 你正站在转身启程的门槛上；身后的八只杯子依然整齐，但你的心早已指向远方山路。

challenge.en: Sunk-cost guilt or fear of disappointing others is tempting you to linger beside cups that already feel empty.
challenge.zh: 沉没成本带来的愧疚感或怕令旁人失望，正拉扯着你继续守在早已不再满盈的杯子旁。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is emotional honesty—willingness to walk away cleanly instead of settling for hollow comfort.
resource.zh: 你最可贵的力量是情感上的诚实——宁可迎着夜色重新出发，也不愿将就于空心的安稳。

action.en: Pack light, set a clear departure date or boundary, and take the first honest step toward what actually calls to you.
action.zh: 轻装收拾、定下明确的告别节点或边界，然后朝着真正召唤你的方向迈出第一步。

outcome.en: If you follow this pull, a meaningful transition is likely to unfold: leaving a finished chapter behind tends to clear the road for deeper purpose and genuine peace.
outcome.zh: 若你顺着这股牵引走下去，一场有分量的转向多半会展开：体面告别已走完的章节，往往能为更深的意义与真正的安宁腾出路来。

advice.en: Walk away without bitterness—you can appreciate what those eight cups held while knowing it is time to seek the ninth.
advice.zh: 不带怨怼地转身离开——你可以感谢这八只圣杯曾给过的一切，同时笃定地去寻找更深层的答案。

hidden.en: You may have already left in spirit and be waiting only for a reason that sounds acceptable. What is missing here has perhaps never been said plainly, even to yourself.
hidden.zh: 你的心也许早就走了，只是在等一个说得出口的理由。这里缺的那样东西，可能从来没有被明白说出来过，连对你自己都没有。

self.en: You are the one quietly walking away: not angry, not dramatic, simply finished. You see yourself as a seeker, willing to give up what is comfortable for what is true.
self.zh: 你是那个安静转身的人：不生气，不闹腾，只是到头了。你把自己看作一个寻找者，愿意为了真实的东西放下舒适。

other.en: The other person appears to be withdrawing: investing less, looking elsewhere, or already halfway out the door. This probably has more to do with their own search than with you, and it may come without argument or warning.
other.zh: 对方看起来正在抽身：投入变少、目光转向别处，或者已经半只脚出了门。这多半跟对方自己的寻找有关，而不是针对你，而且可能不吵不闹、没有预告地到来。

external.en: The setting has given what it can. Nothing is collapsing, yet the place, role, or group has no more to offer you, and conditions quietly favor a departure made at a time you choose.
external.zh: 这个环境能给的已经给完了。没有什么在崩塌，但这个地方、这个角色或这群人已经拿不出更多东西给你，外部条件也在悄悄支持一场由你自己择时的离开。

hopes_fears.en: You hope that something deeper is waiting once you leave, yet fear walking away from eight good cups only to find the hills as empty as what you left.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着离开之后，有更深的东西在等你；又怕自己丢下八只好好的杯子，到头来发现山那边和身后一样空。

general.en: Outgrowing a familiar chapter asks for quiet courage. Leave behind what no longer nourishes your spirit—even if it still looks respectable—and follow the deeper pull uphill.
general.zh: 走出已经不再合身的熟悉章节需要沉静的勇气。即便眼下一切在外人看来依然体面，只要它已不再滋养你，就值得体面转身去追寻更深的意义。

love.en: In love, Eight of Cups signals stepping back from an emotionally stagnant dynamic, or leaving surface habits behind to seek deeper authenticity and mutual presence.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯八指向主动离开情感停滞的关系模式，或告别流于表面的相处惯性，去寻找真正有回应、有深度的亲密联结。

career.en: At work, this is walking away from a role, project, or prestige track that no longer matches your values. Transition deliberately toward work with real personal meaning.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，这张牌代表告别一份看似光鲜却已让你内心空洞的岗位或赛道，有计划地转向真正契合价值观与长期意义的方向。

health.en: Stepping away from draining environments, late-night habits, or emotional noise restores vitality faster than forcing yourself to endure what depletes you.
health.zh: 主动远离持续消耗精力的环境、作息或人际噪音，比咬牙硬撑更能迅速恢复你的身心元气与内在清明。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Eight of Cups is the sacred pilgrimage: answering an inner call that asks you to trade familiar comfort for lived truth.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，圣杯八是一场安静的内在朝圣：回应心底深处的召唤，愿意放下熟悉的安逸，去亲身走近更真实的生命体验。

core.en: Eight of Cups reversed highlights hesitation at the edge of departure: either clinging to a drained situation out of fear of the unknown, or drifting from place to place without facing what needs healing.
core.zh: 圣杯八逆位映照启程边缘的摇摆：要么因害怕未知而死守早已耗竭的现状，要么没有看清内心真正缺什么就盲目四处漂泊。

blocked.en: Staying past the expiration date because the familiar ache feels safer than an unmarked trail.
blocked.zh: 明明早已过期，却因为熟悉的疲惫比未知山路更有安全感而迟迟不肯走。

excess.en: Restlessly bolting at the first sign of friction instead of staying long enough to build depth.
excess.zh: 一遇摩擦就匆忙抽身逃离，没给自己留出沉淀与深耕的时间。

internalized.en: Already emotionally checked out while still going through the motions on the outside.
internalized.zh: 外表仍在按部就班配合，内心其实早已悄悄收拾好行囊离开。

release.en: Finally deciding whether to stay and repair wholeheartedly, or leave cleanly once and for all.
release.zh: 结束悬而未决的消耗：要么全心留下修补，要么干脆彻底告别。

message.en: Decide whether you are staying or going. Half-leaving costs you both options, so either put your heart back in or take it with you.
message.zh: 决定清楚：留下，还是离开。走一半留一半，两头都落空——要么把心重新放回来，要么带着它一起走。

foundation.en: A pattern of almost leaving, or of leaving too quickly, runs under this. Earlier you either stayed long after your heart had gone, or moved on before finding out what was really missing.
foundation.zh: 这件事的底下，有一个“差点离开”或“走得太快”的旧模式。从前你要么在心早已不在之后还留了很久，要么没弄清到底缺什么就匆匆换了地方。

present.en: You are in limbo: physically here and mentally elsewhere, or circling back to something you had walked away from. Nothing is settled, and the indecision itself has become the main event.
present.zh: 你正悬在半空：人在这里，心在别处，或者又绕回了一件已经走开过的事。什么都没定下来，而这份拿不定主意，本身成了眼下最大的事。

challenge.en: Hovering with one foot out the door drains both your present and your future—indecision is heavier than leaving.
challenge.zh: 一只脚已经跨出门槛却迟迟不肯迈步，既耗着当下也耽误前路——摇摆本身比离开更累。

resource.en: Your doubt is worth something: it means you refuse to leave on impulse or stay out of habit. You also know this place from the inside, well enough to judge honestly whether it can still be repaired.
resource.zh: 你的犹豫是有价值的：它说明你既不愿凭一时冲动走，也不愿只凭习惯留。你还从里到外了解这个地方，足以诚实地判断它是否还修得好。

action.en: Give yourself an honest deadline: test whether this situation can genuinely renew, and if not, commit to walking away cleanly.
action.zh: 给自己定一个诚实的观察期限：确认眼前局面是否真有焕新可能；若没有，就干脆利落地启程。

outcome.en: Ending the limbo tends to restore your energy: either a renewed commitment heals the gap, or a clean exit finally frees you.
outcome.zh: 结束悬停状态，精力往往会跟着回流：要么重新投入、填平空缺，要么彻底离开、换来松绑。

advice.en: Stop running in circles and stop stalling out of fear; pick one honest direction and walk it.
advice.zh: 既别盲目逃避，也别因恐惧原地打转；选定一个诚实的方向，稳稳走下去。

hidden.en: Check what you are actually avoiding. It may not be this job, place, or person at all, but a restlessness that would follow you anywhere—or a fear of the unknown dressed up as loyalty.
hidden.zh: 查一查你真正在躲的是什么。可能根本不是这份工作、这个地方或这个人，而是一份走到哪儿都会跟着你的不安——或者是一种对未知的害怕，披上了“忠诚”的外衣。

self.en: You are here with your bag half packed: present in body, noncommittal in everything else. Others can probably sense you holding back, even while you tell yourself you are still deciding.
self.zh: 你像是行李只收拾了一半：人在场，其他方面都不肯表态。就算你告诉自己“还在考虑”，旁人多半也感觉得到你有所保留。

other.en: The other person may be wavering: coming back after pulling away, or staying without really committing. Their behavior looks inconsistent, which suggests the question is not settled on their side either.
other.zh: 对方可能正在摇摆：抽身之后又回来，或留下来却并不真正投入。对方的举动前后不一，看起来这个问题在对方那里也还没有定下来。

external.en: Circumstances make leaving hard or staying easy: obligations, money, other people's expectations, or simply no clear path out. The way forward is unmarked, and that outside uncertainty feeds the delay.
external.zh: 外部条件让离开变难，或让留下变得省事：责任、钱、旁人的期待，或只是看不到一条清楚的出路。前面的路没有标记，这份外在的不确定也在助长拖延。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the situation will somehow fix itself so you never have to choose, yet fear both kinds of regret: leaving something that could have been saved, or staying until it is too late to go.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着局面能自己好起来，这样就不必做选择；又两头都怕后悔：怕离开了本来还救得回的东西，也怕一直留到想走都来不及。

general.en: Notice whether fear of the unknown is keeping you stuck in a finished chapter, or restlessness is making you bolt too soon. Choose deliberately instead of drifting.
general.zh: 圣杯八逆位提醒你分辨自己究竟是因怕未知而困在旧局，还是因浮躁而过早逃离。停止漫无目的地消耗，做一个清醒而干脆的决定。

love.en: In love, reversed Eight of Cups flags staying in an unfulfilling bond out of habit, or running from intimacy right when real depth begins. Be honest about what you truly want.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯八逆位常对应因习惯而滞留在缺乏滋养的关系里，或在亲密刚刚深入时突然退缩。先对自己诚实，再决定去留。

career.en: At work, lingering in a dead-end role out of comfort—or job-hopping without knowing what you are seeking—keeps you tired. Define what fulfillment actually requires first.
career.zh: 在职场上，因安逸而滞留无前景的岗位，或还没想清要什么就频繁跳槽，都会让你倍感疲惫。先写清真正看重的价值，再动身。

health.en: Emotional ambivalence is exhausting your nervous system; making one clean decision about a draining commitment will bring immediate physical relief.
health.zh: 长期悬而未决的内耗正悄悄拖垮神经与睡眠；对那件反复消耗你的事做出干脆决定，身体会立刻轻松许多。

spirituality.en: You cannot outrun an inner question by changing scenery alone; pause, listen closely, and let clarity guide your next step.
spirituality.zh: 单靠更换外在风景无法逃开内心真正的课题；先停下来诚实倾听自己，再让清明指引下一步去向。

archetypeEssence.zh: 水到渠成的满足与惬意——带着感恩与从容，好好享用已经实现的愿望。

core.en: Nine of Cups is the classic wish-fulfillment card: genuine contentment, sensory enjoyment, and pride in what you have cultivated. Let yourself actually enjoy the win instead of immediately moving the goalpost.
core.zh: 圣杯九是经典的“心愿达成”之牌：发自内心的满足感、对生活质感的享受，以及对自己亲手耕耘出成果的笃定自豪。允许自己真正品味这份收获，别急着立刻把标准再往上挪。

message.en: Savor what is working right now; a heartfelt wish or personal milestone looks to be coming together in your favor.
message.zh: 安心享受此刻的顺遂——一个发自内心的愿望或个人里程碑，看来正朝着对你有利的方向成形。

foundation.en: Patient emotional maturity, good taste, and steady self-belief built the abundance you are resting in now.
foundation.zh: 长期沉淀的情绪成熟度、好品味与稳定自信，为你铺就了今天可以安心享用的丰盛。

present.en: You are in a sweet spot of comfort, gratitude, and personal satisfaction; enjoy the warmth generously.
present.zh: 你正处于舒心、自足且充满感恩的甜蜜窗口期；大方享用这份来之不易的从容。

challenge.en: Comfort may be quietly turning into complacency or a touch of smugness; check whether ease has started to look like self-satisfaction.
challenge.zh: 这份安逸可能正悄悄滑向懈怠，或带上一点自鸣得意；留意舒适是否已经开始变成自满。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is grounded confidence—when you feel genuinely whole, you attract goodwill without chasing it.
resource.zh: 你最迷人的底气是踏实的自足感——当你内心本就丰盈时，善意会自然向你靠拢，不必刻意追逐。

action.en: Celebrate your progress openly, treat yourself with real appreciation, and share a slice of the abundance with someone you care about.
action.zh: 坦然庆祝已有的成绩，认真犒劳自己，也把这份丰盛的暖意分给在乎的人。

outcome.en: This course tends toward a deeply gratifying result: a wish fulfilled, a joyful milestone, or a stretch of genuine emotional ease.
outcome.zh: 照这样走下去，多半会迎来一个令人由衷欣喜的结果：心愿落地、阶段圆满，或一段真正舒心自在的时光。

advice.en: Receive the good without guilt; gratitude keeps satisfaction warm and generous rather than hollow.
advice.zh: 不必带着愧疚去接住好运；常怀感恩，能让满足始终温暖慷慨，而不流于浅薄。

hidden.en: Things may be going better than you have let yourself notice. Check whether a wish has already been granted in a form you did not expect, and whether you are keeping your satisfaction quiet for fear of jinxing it.
hidden.zh: 事情可能比你允许自己察觉的要顺。看看某个愿望是不是已经以你没料到的形式实现了——以及你是不是怕说破了就不灵，才把这份满足悄悄藏着。

self.en: You show up comfortable in your own skin, pleased with what you have built and unafraid to enjoy it. You bring the ease of a good host: generous, settled, with nothing to prove.
self.zh: 你在这件事里很自在，对自己做成的事感到满意，也不怕享受它。你带来的是好主人的那种从容：大方、安稳，不需要证明什么。

other.en: Whoever you are dealing with appears satisfied and at ease, content with how things stand and pleased with their position. They are likely to be welcoming and generous, though in no hurry to change an arrangement that suits them.
other.zh: 对方看起来满意而放松，对现状感到舒服，对自己的位置也挺得意。对方多半会热情大方，不过对一个合自己心意的安排，并不急着去改变。

external.en: Conditions are favorable and well supplied: resources are available, people are in a generous mood, and the timing suits asking for what you want. For now, circumstances are on your side.
external.zh: 外部条件有利，供给也充足：资源拿得到，人们心情大方，时机适合开口要你想要的东西。眼下的环境是站在你这边的。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes to get exactly what you wished for and be wholly satisfied; another part fears that once you have it, the feeling will not last—or will not be enough.
hopes_fears.zh: 你一面盼着恰好得到许下的那个愿望，并因此彻底满足；一面又怕真的到手之后，这份感觉留不住——或者其实并不够。

general.en: Contentment, gratitude, and personal fulfillment take center stage. Enjoy the fruits of your effort openly and let this period of ease replenish your spirit.
general.zh: 发自内心的满足、感恩与个人成就感成为此刻核心。大方享用你用心换来的成果，让这段舒心顺遂的时光好好滋养自己。

love.en: In love, Nine of Cups radiates warmth, sensuality, and emotional security—feeling genuinely happy in your own skin makes intimacy relaxed, playful, and generous.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯九散发着温暖、愉悦与安稳的魅力——先在自己身上感到踏实欢喜，亲密互动也会随之变得松弛、甜蜜而慷慨。

career.en: At work, this marks well-earned recognition, a satisfying reward, or a project landing just as you hoped. Take pride in the craft and share credit warmly.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，这张牌代表实至名归的认可、令人满意的回报，或项目如愿顺利收官。为自己的手艺感到自豪，也大方分享这份喜悦。

health.en: For wellbeing, pleasure and rest are restorative right now—good food, deep sleep, and unhurried enjoyment support vitality far better than rigid self-denial.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，适度的愉悦与放松此刻格外养人——美味饮食、安稳睡眠与不赶时间的享受，比严苛克制更能提升生命活力。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Nine of Cups teaches that joy and gratitude are not distractions from growth; appreciating what is already abundant is a form of deep wisdom.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，圣杯九提醒你喜悦与感恩本身就是修习；由衷珍惜此刻已然丰盛的一切，便是最踏实的智慧。

core.en: Nine of Cups reversed reveals the gap between looking successful and feeling fulfilled: chasing surface indulgence, smugness, or realizing a wish still feels strangely hollow inside.
core.zh: 圣杯九逆位照见“表面风光”与“内心满足”之间的落差：过度纵容感官、流于自满，或发现如愿以偿后心里却莫名空落落的。

blocked.en: Refusing to let yourself enjoy good things because you are waiting for the next shoe to drop.
blocked.zh: 总担心好运转瞬即逝，明明事情很顺却不肯允许自己真正开心。

excess.en: Overindulgence, vanity, or boasting to cover up a quieter inner restlessness.
excess.zh: 用过度享乐、虚荣或炫耀来遮盖心底那份挥之不去的不安。

internalized.en: Private dissatisfaction—getting what you thought you wanted and realizing your heart wants something deeper.
internalized.zh: 独自品尝的微妙空虚——拿到了当初以为想要的，才发现内心渴望的其实更深。

release.en: Trading shallow status-chasing for simpler, more honest contentment.
release.zh: 放下浮于表面的攀比与堆砌，回到更朴素而真实的满足感。

message.en: Having it and enjoying it are two different things. Ask what you actually want underneath the wish you have been chasing.
message.zh: “拥有”和“享受”是两回事。问问自己：在你一直追着的那个愿望底下，真正想要的是什么？

foundation.en: You got something you wanted, or worked hard to look as if you had, and the satisfaction did not arrive as promised. That gap between the prize and the feeling is where this began.
foundation.zh: 你得到了想要的东西，或者费了很大劲让自己看起来得到了，可满足感并没有如约而至。奖品和感受之间的那道落差，就是这件事的起点。

present.en: On paper things look good; inside, something is flat. You may be eating, spending, scrolling, or showing off a little more than usual to cover a restlessness you cannot quite name.
present.zh: 从表面看，一切都挺好；心里却有什么地方是瘪的。你可能比平时吃得多一点、花得多一点、刷得久一点，或更爱晒一点，好盖住一份说不清的不安。

challenge.en: Seeking applause or quick comfort is distracting you from what would actually make you feel whole.
challenge.zh: 追逐外界掌声或即时慰藉，正让你偏离真正能令内心踏实的事物。

resource.en: The hollow feeling is honest feedback: it tells you this version of success is not the one you need. You have also learned what does not satisfy, which narrows the search for what does.
resource.zh: 那份空落落的感觉是诚实的反馈：它告诉你，这种版本的成功不是你需要的那一种。你也已经弄清什么满足不了自己，这让寻找真正对味的东西容易了一些。

action.en: Check your motive before indulging or boasting—scale back one excess and ask what genuinely nourishes you when nobody is watching.
action.zh: 在放纵或炫耀前先停一秒自问：缩减一项过度消耗，找回无人注视时依然让你舒心的事。

outcome.en: Honest recalibration is likely to replace hollow glitter with a quieter, much more durable satisfaction.
outcome.zh: 诚实的校准，多半能用沉静而长久得多的满足感，取代空洞的表面光鲜。

advice.en: Distinguish real nourishment from numbing excess; enough is a feeling, not a number.
advice.zh: 分清真正的滋养与麻木式的过量消费；“足够”是一种内在感受，从来不是一个数字。

hidden.en: Ask whether the display of contentment is aimed at an audience. Behind it there may be envy, loneliness, or a wish you have been too proud to admit you still hold.
hidden.zh: 问一问那份“我很满足”的样子，是不是摆给别人看的。它背后也许有羡慕、有孤单，或一个你因为好面子而不肯承认还揣着的愿望。

self.en: You look polished and fine on the surface, and privately you are unconvinced. Either you are denying yourself pleasure you have earned, or reaching for more of it than you can actually taste.
self.zh: 你表面上光鲜体面、一切都好，私下却并不信服。你要么不肯让自己享受本就应得的快乐，要么伸手抓了太多，多到已经尝不出味道。

other.en: The other person may be putting on a show of having it all: boasting a little, indulging a lot, keeping talk on the surface. Their satisfaction appears less solid than they present it, though only they know why.
other.zh: 对方可能正在表演“什么都有了”：有点爱炫耀、相当放纵，说话只停留在表面。对方的满足看起来没有展示出来的那么结实，至于原因，只有对方自己清楚。

external.en: The environment rewards appearances: status, comparison, and conspicuous comfort set the tone, and quick pleasures are easy to come by. Little around you encourages asking whether any of it is nourishing.
external.zh: 这个环境奖励的是表面：身份、攀比和摆在明处的舒适定下了调子，即时的快乐唾手可得。你周围很少有什么会鼓励你去问：这些到底滋不滋养人？

hopes_fears.en: You hope the next achievement or treat will finally make you feel full, yet fear that nothing will—that the emptiness is not about what you have at all.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着下一个成就或下一次犒赏终于能让你觉得饱足；又怕什么都不管用——怕那份空，根本就跟你拥有多少无关。

general.en: Surface comfort is not quite matching inner fulfillment. Step back from overindulgence or keeping up appearances and ask what your heart actually hungers for.
general.zh: 圣杯九逆位提示外在的丰盛尚未真正填满内心。从过度放纵或维持体面中退后一步，诚实问问自己心里真正渴望的是什么。

love.en: In love, reversed Nine of Cups cautions against superficial charm, emotional smugness, or expecting a partner to validate your ego. Cultivate deeper honesty.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯九逆位提醒警惕流于表面的取悦、自我中心的傲慢，或指望伴侣来满足虚荣心。回到真诚平等的深层互动。

career.en: At work, hitting a metric that leaves you cold—or getting complacent after an early win—calls for a sharper sense of purpose and humility.
career.zh: 在职场上，达成目标却毫无喜悦，或因小有成就而松懈自满，都在提醒你保持谦逊，重新校准真正有意义的追求。

health.en: Watch for comfort eating, late-night excess, or ignoring moderation; gentler balance restores energy better than extremes.
health.zh: 留意用暴饮暴食、熬夜放纵来解压的惯性；温和有节制的日常节奏，比大起大落的放纵更能真正滋养身体。

spirituality.en: Notice where chasing shiny external wishes has crowded out quiet inner peace; true abundance begins with honest self-acceptance.
spirituality.zh: 觉察追逐外在光鲜愿望是否挤占了内心的安静；真正的丰盛始于诚实接纳自己，而非不断向外索取证明。

promptSpec.suitAccent: luminous cerulean-sapphire, moonstone amethyst, shimmering pearl highlights, gleaming gilded chalices, moonlit ivory
promptSpec.scene: Seated comfortably in the center of a warm, candlelit Belle Epoque salon alcove, ONE contented, warmly smiling figure in an embroidered ivory silk shirt and sapphire-velvet waistcoat sits relaxed on a carved wooden bench with arms comfortably folded in quiet pride. Directly behind the figure, draped in rich cerulean-sapphire velvet across a curved semicircular console, stand EXACTLY NINE gleaming, ornate antique-gold chalices arranged in a crisp, symmetrical, unbroken curved arc so every single cup is clearly separated and easily countable. Warm golden candlelight and soft moonlit highlights illuminate the figure's joyful face, hands, and all nine gilded chalices against velvety deep midnight-indigo Art Nouveau paneled walls.

requiredObjects.object: ornate golden chalices arrayed in a curved arc behind host
contented seated host

archetypeEssence.en: Emotional belonging that ripples outward—shared harmony, home, and lasting joy.
archetypeEssence.zh: 向外荡漾的情感归属——家人与所爱之人共筑的和谐、安稳与长久欢喜。

en: Embracing couple raising their arms joyfully toward a luminous rainbow spanning the sky
Ten gleaming golden cups arrayed cleanly along the radiant rainbow arc overhead
Two playful children dancing beside them in carefree security
Peaceful riverside cottage nestled among green hills symbolizing lasting home
zh: 相拥举臂、满怀喜悦仰望天际彩虹的伴侣
整齐悬列在绚丽虹弧之上的十只闪亮金杯
身旁无忧无虑翩然起舞的两个孩子
远方临水而建的宁静小屋，象征长久安稳的家园

en: Joyous Belle Epoque couple standing in warm embrace on a moonlit hillside meadow, lifting their arms toward a radiant celestial rainbow arc
Exactly ten gleaming antique-gold chalices arrayed evenly and unmistakably along the luminous pearl-sapphire-gold rainbow spanning the upper sky
Two cheerful children dancing hand-in-hand in the foreground meadow beside a glowing cerulean river and warm lantern-lit cottage
High-key luminous ivory, cerulean, amethyst, and molten-gold atmosphere glowing against starry deep twilight indigo
zh: 在月色山坡草地上相拥举臂、仰望璀璨天际虹弧的美好年代伴侣
沿着珍珠蓝金微光彩虹清晰排布的十只古金雕花圣杯
身旁牵手欢舞的两个孩童、微光河流与远方亮着暖灯的河畔小屋
星夜靛蓝背景中明亮温润的月白、蓝宝石、紫晶与鎏金光辉

core.en: Ten of Cups is emotional fulfillment shared with the people who matter most: harmony at home, genuine belonging, and the quiet relief of knowing your heart has a place to land.
core.zh: 圣杯十代表与最重要的人共享的情感圆满：家与亲密圈里的和谐安定，以及心有所栖、彼此托底的踏实松弛。

message.en: Invest in the bonds that feel like home—lasting happiness here is built together, not hoarded alone.
message.zh: 把心力投向那些让你有归属感的关系——这里的长久喜悦是彼此共筑出来的，而非独自占有。

foundation.en: Shared values, loyalty, and deep mutual care laid the warm emotional foundation supporting you now.
foundation.zh: 共同的价值观、长久忠诚与彼此照拂，搭起了此刻托住你的温暖根基。

present.en: Harmony and emotional alignment are flowing freely; pause to appreciate the people standing beside you.
present.zh: 和谐与情感共鸣正顺畅流动；停下来好好珍惜此刻站在你身边的这些人。

challenge.en: Chasing a picture-perfect ideal may be distracting you from appreciating the real, imperfect love already in front of you.
challenge.zh: 执着于“完美无瑕的理想画面”，可能正让你忽略眼前真实却并不完美的爱。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is a loving, aligned circle—family, chosen family, or a deeply united team that has your back.
resource.zh: 你最厚实的底气是一个彼此对齐、充满爱意的圈子——家人、挚友或高度默契的团队正稳稳支持着你。

action.en: Gather your people, express clear gratitude, and make a concrete choice that protects your shared peace and home life.
action.zh: 把在乎的人聚在一起、真诚说出感谢，并做一个切实守护共同安宁与家庭生活的决定。

outcome.en: If this course holds, it tends toward a deeply fulfilling chapter of harmony, belonging, and shared joy, something durable enough to build a life on.
outcome.zh: 若照此走下去，多半会展开一段充满归属感、和谐与共享欢喜的篇章，稳固得足以托起长远的生活。

advice.en: Protect what gives your life warmth; true wealth is measured in the ease you feel when you walk through the door.
advice.zh: 守护那些让生活有温度的人与事；真正的富足，是推开家门那一刻由衷的安心。

hidden.en: You may already have more of the belonging you want than you give yourself credit for. Look for the steady, unremarkable loyalty of the people close to you; it may be holding this situation up unseen.
hidden.zh: 你想要的归属感，也许其实已经拥有了不少，只是自己没算进去。去留意亲近的人那份稳定而不起眼的忠诚，它可能正在看不见的地方托着这件事。

self.en: You show up as someone who puts the people you love at the center: loyal, grateful, thinking in terms of 'us'. What you bring is the wish to make a home of this, not just a win.
self.zh: 你是把所爱的人放在中心的那个人：忠诚、懂得感恩，凡事从“我们”出发。你带来的心愿，是把这里过成一个家，而不只是赢一局。

other.en: The other person appears committed and family-minded, including you in their plans and treating your happiness as part of theirs. Their behavior suggests they are looking for something lasting.
other.zh: 对方看起来是认真的，也很看重家，把你放进自己的计划里，把你的快乐当成自己快乐的一部分。从举动上看，对方想要的是能长久的东西。

external.en: The home front and the wider circle are supportive: family, close friends, or a tight-knit community are in harmony and glad to back you. Conditions are settled, like fair weather after rain.
external.zh: 家里和更大的圈子都是支持的：家人、密友或一个关系紧密的群体相处和睦，也乐意做你的后盾。外部条件是安稳的，像雨后放晴的天气。

hopes_fears.en: You hope for the whole picture—love that lasts, a peaceful home, people who are truly yours—yet fear that such happiness is fragile, or that you are not the kind of person who gets to keep it.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着那幅完整的画面——长久的爱、安宁的家、真正属于你的人；又怕这样的幸福太脆，或者自己不是那种留得住它的人。

general.en: Lasting harmony, heartfelt belonging, and shared joy define this moment. Align your choices with the people and values that make life feel genuinely whole.
general.zh: 长久的和谐、真挚的归属感与共享的喜悦定义着这一刻。让你的选择与那些真正让生命感到完整的人和价值保持一致。

love.en: In love, Ten of Cups marks deep commitment, emotional safety, and building a joyful shared future together—where affection, trust, and daily life fit hand in glove.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯十象征深厚承诺、情感安全感与共同搭建幸福未来的愿景——爱意、信任与日常烟火彼此严丝合缝。

career.en: At work, this reflects a genuinely supportive culture, meaningful work-life harmony, or a milestone that benefits your whole team and household alike.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，这张牌映照出彼此托举的团队氛围、舒心的工作生活平衡，或一项让团队与家人都共享红利的圆满成果。

health.en: Emotional peace and supportive loved ones create a strong container for wellbeing; shared meals, laughter, and calm home rhythms nourish you deeply.
health.zh: 内心的安稳与亲友的温暖陪伴是最好的身心容器；一顿热腾腾的家常饭、轻松笑声与规律生活都在深层滋养着你。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Ten of Cups sees the sacred inside ordinary love: gratitude, community, and peace shared across generations.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，圣杯十在寻常爱意中看见神圣：感恩、联结与代代相传的温暖安宁，本身就是最圆满的祝福。

core.en: Ten of Cups reversed points to friction beneath a polished surface—unspoken family tension, misaligned values, or chasing a storybook ideal instead of tending real-world connection.
core.zh: 圣杯十逆位揭示体面表象下的细微裂痕——未说破的家庭摩擦、价值观错位，或执着于童话滤镜而忽略了真实关系的日常经营。

blocked.en: Polite silence around home or relational tensions keeps real warmth from circulating.
blocked.zh: 对家庭或亲密关系里的分歧避而不谈，让真正的暖意流通不起来。

excess.en: Perfectionism about 'how a happy life should look' creating pressure instead of joy.
excess.zh: 执着于“幸福生活该有的标准模板”，反而制造出沉重压力而非喜悦。

internalized.en: Quietly feeling out of place even inside a familiar circle or household.
internalized.zh: 身处熟悉的圈子或家庭之中，内心却隐约感到格格不入。

release.en: Letting go of performative harmony so honest, imperfect, real closeness can heal.
release.zh: 放下刻意维持的表面圆满，让诚实、带点瑕疵却真实的亲密慢慢修复。

message.en: The picture does not have to be perfect to be worth keeping. Tend the real relationships in front of you rather than the ideal version in your head.
message.zh: 画面不必完美，也值得好好留着。去照料眼前这些真实的关系，而不是脑子里那个理想的版本。

foundation.en: A long habit of keeping the peace by not mentioning things lies under this, or an image of the 'happy family' that nobody could live up to. Small disconnections were smoothed over rather than repaired.
foundation.zh: 这件事的底下，是一个长年靠“不提就没事”来维持和气的习惯，或一幅谁也达不到的“幸福一家”的图景。那些小小的隔阂，一直是被抹平，而不是被修好。

present.en: Things look harmonious from outside while something at home or in your closest circle is slightly off: polite distance, different priorities, a subject everyone steps around. The warmth is there but not circulating freely.
present.zh: 从外面看一切和睦，但家里或你最亲的圈子里有什么地方微微不对：客气的距离、不同的优先级、一个人人绕着走的话题。暖意是有的，只是流动得不顺畅。

challenge.en: Comparing your real life to an idealized rainbow—or avoiding an honest household conversation—is draining genuine joy.
challenge.zh: 拿真实生活去对比完美滤镜，或回避一场早该进行的坦诚家常对话，正在悄悄耗损真实的快乐。

resource.en: The bond under the tension is still real, and that is the asset: people who did not care would not feel the strain. Dropping the need to look perfect also frees energy for honest repair.
resource.zh: 紧绷底下的那份感情仍然是真的，这就是可用的资本：不在乎的人，根本不会觉得别扭。放下“必须看起来完美”的需要，也能腾出力气来做诚实的修补。

action.en: Drop the performance of perfection and have one kind, honest talk about what everyone actually needs right now.
action.zh: 放下“必须显得一切完美”的包袱，发起一次温和坦诚的对话，听听彼此当下真正需要什么。

outcome.en: Releasing unrealistic expectations tends to clear the air, allowing a steadier, more authentic harmony to rebuild.
outcome.zh: 松开不切实际的期待，往往能让空气重新清朗，更踏实、更真实的和谐也有机会逐步重建。

advice.en: Real harmony is repaired in plain daylight, never maintained by pretending nothing is wrong.
advice.zh: 真正的和谐是在坦诚对话中一点点修补出来的，从不是靠假装风平浪静撑出来的。

hidden.en: Check whether you feel like an outsider in your own circle and have been hiding it. A difference in values, or an old family rule nobody states, may be quietly shaping what can and cannot be said.
hidden.zh: 查一查你是不是在自己的圈子里觉得像个外人，并且一直藏着没说。也许有一处价值观上的分歧，或一条没人明讲的家里老规矩，正悄悄决定着什么能说、什么不能说。

self.en: You are the one holding the happy picture together: smiling for the photo, managing everyone's mood, saying little about your own doubts. It costs you more than you admit.
self.zh: 你在这里是那个撑着“幸福画面”的人：对着镜头微笑、照顾每个人的情绪，对自己的疑虑却很少提。这样做的代价，比你承认的要大。

other.en: The other person, or the family around you, may be keeping up appearances: agreeable on the surface, avoiding the harder conversation, pulling in a slightly different direction from yours. They appear present but not quite aligned.
other.zh: 对方或家里人可能正在维持表面：嘴上和气，躲着那场更难的谈话，使劲的方向也跟你不太一样。他们看起来人在，步调却没有完全对齐。

external.en: Family expectations, social comparison, and other people's ideas of a proper happy life press on this situation. Household circumstances may be unsettled too: a move, a strain, or relatives who do not agree.
external.zh: 家里的期待、与旁人的比较，还有别人眼中“像样的幸福生活”，都压在这件事上。家里的状况可能也不太安稳：一次搬迁、一份压力，或意见不合的亲人。

hopes_fears.en: Your hope is that the people you love can be honest with each other and still stay close; your fear is that naming the crack will break the whole picture.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望所爱的人能彼此说实话，同时还亲近如常，却也担心把裂缝说破，整幅画面就碎了。

general.en: A gap between idealized harmony and messy reality asks for honest care. Release perfectionist expectations and address small disconnections warmly before they widen.
general.zh: 圣杯十逆位提醒你正视理想圆满与琐碎现实之间的落差。放下完美主义标准，趁小隔阂尚未扩大时温和沟通、及时修补。

love.en: In love, reversed Ten of Cups flags mismatched domestic expectations, family pressure, or feeling disconnected under the same roof. Rebuild intimacy through plain, gentle truth.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯十逆位对应生活步调不合、家庭意见介入或同处一室却心有距离。用温和坦诚的日常对话重新接通彼此。

career.en: At work, values friction or work spilling over into personal peace needs firmer boundaries. Reclaim time for what actually sustains you outside the job.
career.zh: 在职场上，团队理念摩擦或工作过度挤占私人生活，都在提示你重新划清边界，把精力还给真正滋养你的生活根基。

health.en: Household stress or trying to keep everyone else happy can quietly wear you down; protect simple personal downtime without guilt.
health.zh: 家庭琐事的压力或总想让所有人都满意的操心正悄悄透支你；不带愧疚地为自己留出安静独处的喘息时间。

spirituality.en: True belonging starts when you stop editing yourself to fit a borrowed picture of happiness.
spirituality.zh: 当你不再为了迎合他人眼中的幸福模板而修剪自己时，真正踏实的归属感才会从内在生根。

promptSpec.suitAccent: luminous cerulean-sapphire, moonstone amethyst, shimmering pearl water highlights, gleaming gilded chalices, moonlit ivory
promptSpec.scene: On a radiant moonlit hillside meadow overlooking a shimmering cerulean stream and a cozy warm-lit stone cottage in the distance, ONE joyful Belle Epoque couple in flowing sapphire and ivory-gold garments stand closely embraced from behind, lifting their arms joyfully toward the sky while TWO laughing children dance hand-in-hand beside them. Spanning cleanly across the luminous upper twilight sky is a glowing iridescent pearl, cerulean, amethyst, and gold rainbow arc along which EXACTLY TEN gleaming, ornate antique-gold chalices are spaced evenly and unmistakably in one continuous sweeping curve. Warm celestial moonlight and radiant golden highlights illuminate the ten rainbow chalices, the embracing family, and the blooming meadow against a starry deep indigo sky.

embracing couple raising arms in joy

distant warm-lit cottage by river

archetypeEssence.en: Playful intuition and an unexpected tender spark—curiosity greeting wonder with an open hand.
archetypeEssence.zh: 灵动好奇的直觉与意想不到的温柔讯息——带着少年般的敞开去迎接惊喜。

en: Youthful Page standing at the edge of gentle sea waves in a lotus-patterned tunic
Single golden chalice held up at eye level with a small blue fish peeking playfully out of the rim
Soft flowing beret and open, delighted expression signaling imaginative receptivity
Calm coastal shoreline symbolizing the meeting of conscious craft and intuitive tides
zh: 立于轻柔海浪岸边、身着莲纹长衫的年轻侍从
平举在眼前的单只金色圣杯，一条小蓝鱼正俏皮地从杯口探出头
轻盈柔软的帽饰与欣喜好奇的神情，象征丰沛想象力
平缓海岸线，代表现实探索与直觉浪潮的交汇

en: Luminous Belle Epoque Page standing on a moonlit coastal shore in a cerulean-and-ivory silk tunic embroidered with golden water lilies
Exactly one gleaming ornate antique-gold chalice held steadily in the Page's right hand, with ONE small iridescent silver-sapphire fish peeking curiously from the cup's rim
Gentle curling pearl-crested midnight waves lapping behind the Page under a starry sapphire sky
Warm moonlit-ivory highlights on the Page's delighted face, graceful hands, and the single chalice with its peeking fish
zh: 立于月色海滨、身着绣有金色睡莲纹的蓝白丝绸短袍的美好年代侍从
右手稳稳托起的一只古金雕花圣杯，杯沿探出一条泛着银蓝珠光的灵动小鱼
身后在星夜蓝天下轻拍海岸的珍珠微光海浪
温润月白色高光点亮侍从惊喜柔和的面容、双手与杯中小鱼

core.en: Page of Cups brings a sweet, unexpected creative nudge or heartfelt message: a shy confession, a fresh artistic idea, or an intuitive hunch that feels slightly whimsical yet surprisingly true.
core.zh: 圣杯侍从带来一份轻盈而意想不到的灵感或温柔讯息：也许是一句真诚示好、一个灵光一闪的创意，或某个看似天马行空却格外准确的直觉。

message.en: Stay curious and lightly playful—an unexpected creative idea or warm message is peeking right out of the cup.
message.zh: 保持轻盈的好奇心——一个出人意料的创意或温暖讯息，正从杯口俏皮地探出头来。

foundation.en: A tender early curiosity, gentle crush, or playful artistic impulse set this whole story in motion.
foundation.zh: 最初那份纯粹的好奇、青涩的好感或好玩的心动，轻轻推开了整段故事。

present.en: Fresh emotional openness and creative sensitivity are active right now; treat small hunches as worth exploring.
present.zh: 你当下的情感感受力与创意直觉格外敏锐；别轻视那些细小却鲜活的念头，它们很值得顺藤摸瓜。

challenge.en: Daydreaming or shyness may be keeping a lovely idea from being spoken aloud; notice what you are rehearsing privately instead of saying.
challenge.zh: 害羞，或只顾着沉浸在想象里，可能正让一个好主意迟迟说不出口；留意哪些话你只在心里排练过。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is beginner's wonder—approaching this with warmth and playfulness disarms stiffness immediately.
resource.zh: 你最灵动的优势是赤子般的好奇心——带着温和与玩心切入，能瞬间化解紧绷与僵局。

action.en: Follow the small intuitive spark—sketch the rough draft, send the kind note, or ask the curious question today.
action.zh: 顺着那个小小的直觉火花行动——画出第一版草图、发去那句温柔问候，或抛出那个好奇的问题。

outcome.en: This is likely to bring a pleasant surprise, a heartfelt invitation, or a creative seed starting to bloom, and with it some fresh lightness in your week.
outcome.zh: 接下来多半会出现一个令人微笑的小惊喜、一份真诚的邀约，或一颗开始萌芽的创意种子，为你这一周添上几分轻盈。

advice.en: Do not laugh off the fish in the cup—gentle imagination often spots truths that rigid logic misses.
advice.zh: 别急着把杯里探头的小鱼当成玩笑——柔和的想象力常常能看见死板逻辑漏掉的真相。

hidden.en: A small feeling or idea you have been treating as silly may deserve more attention than it is getting. Check, too, for a message that has not reached you yet; a kind word may still be waiting for its moment.
hidden.zh: 一个被你当成“犯傻”的小感觉或小念头，也许值得更多留意。也看看有没有一条还没送到的讯息——一句好话，可能还在等它的时机。

self.en: You show up curious and a little shy, more ready to wonder than to judge. You bring a beginner's openness and a soft heart, and you would rather offer something sincere than something polished.
self.zh: 你带着好奇而来，也有点害羞，比起下判断，更愿意先看看再说。你带来的是初学者的敞开和一颗柔软的心，宁可拿出真诚的东西，也不追求打磨得漂亮。

other.en: The person on the other side appears gentle and tentative: dropping hints, sending small friendly signals, or offering something a bit awkwardly. Their interest is likely sincere, though still young and easily discouraged.
other.zh: 对方看起来温和，也带着试探：给点暗示、发些友好的小信号，或有点笨拙地递来什么。这份兴趣多半是真诚的，只是还很嫩，容易被吓退。

external.en: Small surprises are arriving from outside: an unexpected message, a kind invitation, a creative opening nobody planned. The mood around you is light and friendly, and news tends to come from unlikely directions.
external.zh: 小小的意外正从外面到来：一条没料到的消息、一份善意的邀请、一个没人计划过的创作机会。你周围的气氛轻松友好，消息常从意想不到的方向传来。

hopes_fears.en: You hope your tender offering—a feeling, an idea, a first attempt—will be welcomed, yet fear being laughed at or told it was childish to try.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着自己递出的那份柔软——一份感情、一个想法、一次初次尝试——能被欢迎；又怕被人笑话，或被说一句“这么做太幼稚”。

general.en: Curiosity, gentle intuition, and pleasant surprises brighten the path. Meet new impressions with an open, unguarded mind and let small sparks grow before judging them.
general.zh: 好奇心、柔和直觉与意想不到的小惊喜正点亮前路。用不设防的敞开心态接住新鲜灵感，在急着评判之前先让它自然生长。

love.en: In love, Page of Cups brings sweet flirtation, a sincere apology, or tender vulnerability. Small thoughtful gestures and playful honesty warm the connection right away.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯侍从带来青涩甜蜜的好感、真诚的致歉或温柔的敞开心扉。一个细心的小举动和俏皮的坦诚，就能立刻拉近彼此。

career.en: At work, this is fresh creative ideation, a promising entry-level spark, or good news arriving through an unexpected channel. Prototype playfully before over-engineering.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，这张牌代表鲜活的创意萌芽、值得尝试的新机会，或意料之外的好消息。先轻巧做出原型试水，不必一开始就过度设计。

health.en: For wellbeing, gentle creative play, music, dreaming, and listening to subtle bodily cues restore lightness without harsh discipline.
health.zh: 在身心调节上，轻松的艺术小消遣、音乐、好梦与倾听身体细微的信号，比严苛自律更能帮你找回轻盈状态。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Page of Cups is intuitive listening: notice synchronicities, dreams, and quiet inner nudges with humble delight.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，圣杯侍从代表敏锐的直觉倾听：带着谦逊而欢喜的心，去留意梦境、巧合与心底轻轻响起的提示。

core.en: Page of Cups reversed points to creative shyness, touchy sensitivity, or retreating into moody escapism instead of voicing what you genuinely feel.
core.zh: 圣杯侍从逆位指向创作上的自我怀疑、敏感玻璃心，或用赌气与逃避代替直接说出真实感受。

blocked.en: Self-doubt or fear of looking naive is bottling up a genuine creative or emotional impulse.
blocked.zh: 怕显得幼稚或被挑剔，把原本真挚的创意与心意死死捂在心里。

excess.en: Taking minor feedback personally or sulking instead of naming a hurt directly.
excess.zh: 把一点小反馈过度放大成针对自己，或用闷闷不乐代替直接沟通。

internalized.en: Rich private daydreams that never quite cross the bridge into real-world expression.
internalized.zh: 内心戏与白日梦很丰富，却迟迟没有跨过门槛变成现实表达。

release.en: Outgrowing touchiness and sharing your real voice with steady, grounded confidence.
release.zh: 走出敏感防备，带着更稳的自信把真实想法落落大方地说出来。

message.en: Say the thing you have been hinting at. A feeling kept as a daydream or a sulk helps no one, least of all you.
message.zh: 把你一直在暗示的那句话直接说出来。只停在白日梦或闷气里的感受，帮不了任何人，更帮不了你自己。

foundation.en: An early experience of being teased, criticized, or not taken seriously taught you to keep tender things hidden. That old sting is behind the shyness and the quick hurt in this situation.
foundation.zh: 早年被取笑、被挑剔，或不被当回事的经历，教会了你把柔软的东西藏起来。眼下的怯场和一碰就疼，都来自那根旧刺。

present.en: You are in a tender, touchy patch: easily hurt, slow to share, spending more time imagining conversations than having them. The idea or feeling is real, but it is still stuck on the inside.
present.zh: 你正处在一段又软又敏感的时期：容易受伤，迟迟不肯分享，花在脑中预演对话上的时间，比真正开口的多。那个想法或感受是真的，只是还卡在心里。

challenge.en: Touchy pride or creative hesitation is turning a small vulnerability into unnecessary drama or silence.
challenge.zh: 敏感的自尊或创作怯场，正把一点小小的脆弱放大成不必要的内耗或沉默。

resource.en: Your sensitivity is the raw material, not the flaw: the same thin skin that bruises easily also notices what others miss. The daydreams are a stockpile of ideas waiting for one small real-world outlet.
resource.zh: 你的敏感是原材料，不是缺陷：那份一碰就疼的细腻，同样能察觉别人漏掉的东西。那些白日梦是一仓库的点子，只等一个小小的现实出口。

action.en: Name the feeling plainly without sulking, and share one rough unfinished piece before your inner critic edits it to death.
action.zh: 不带赌气地直接说出感受，也趁着内在挑剔者还没下手前，先交出一版不完美的初稿。

outcome.en: Once sensitivity is grounded in honesty, creative flow and emotional ease tend to return without the drama.
outcome.zh: 当敏感落回诚实表达，创作灵感与情绪上的轻松往往会重新回来，不再被内耗拖累。

advice.en: Protect your tender ideas without hiding them forever; imperfect expression beats silent resentment.
advice.zh: 保护你柔软的想法，但别永远藏着它；不完美的表达胜过沉默的委屈。

hidden.en: A small hurt may be getting nursed in private instead of mentioned. Check for an unspoken wish to be noticed, reassured, or simply asked, sitting behind the moodiness.
hidden.zh: 也许有一处小伤，正被你私下捂着，而没有说出来。查一查闷闷不乐的背后，是不是有一个没开口的愿望：想被留意、被安抚，或只是被人问一句。

self.en: You are guarded about something that matters to you: hinting instead of saying, withdrawing when you feel slighted. You see yourself as misunderstood, yet may have given people little to go on.
self.zh: 对一件你很在乎的事，你是设着防的：只暗示不明说，一觉得被怠慢就缩回去。你觉得自己不被理解，可你留给别人用来理解你的线索，也许并不多。

other.en: The other person may be acting immaturely: moody, easily offended, evasive about what they want, or making sweet gestures that go nowhere. Their behavior appears oversensitive rather than ill-meant.
other.zh: 对方的表现可能有些不成熟：情绪化、容易被冒犯、对自己想要什么含糊其辞，或做些甜蜜却没有下文的举动。这些看起来更像是过于敏感，而不是存心不良。

external.en: Signals from outside are unreliable for now: messages delayed or mixed, invitations that fizzle, feedback delivered clumsily. The atmosphere is a bit oversensitive, so small remarks carry more charge than intended.
external.zh: 眼下来自外部的信号不太可靠：消息延迟或前后矛盾，邀约不了了之，反馈说得很笨拙。气氛有点过于敏感，一句小话带的分量常常超出本意。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes someone will see what you are carrying inside without your having to explain it; another part fears that if you do show it, it will be dismissed as naive.
hopes_fears.zh: 你一面盼着有人不用你解释，就能看见你心里揣着的东西；一面又怕真拿出来了，只换来一句“太天真”。

general.en: Check for bruised sensitivity, creative procrastination, or escapist daydreaming. Ground your feelings in plain words and one small real-world step.
general.zh: 圣杯侍从逆位提醒你留意过度敏感、创作拖延或沉溺空想。把情绪落回直白表达，并用一个微小却真实的行动打破卡顿。

love.en: In love, reversed Page of Cups flags mixed emotional maturity—pouting, fishing for reassurance, or holding back a sincere message out of fear of rejection.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯侍从逆位常对应不够成熟的情绪试探、暗自赌气求安抚，或因怕被拒绝而把真心话吞回去。直接说清反而更轻松。

career.en: At work, creative block or taking critique too personally slows progress. Treat feedback as craft data rather than a verdict on your worth.
career.zh: 在工作上，灵感卡壳或把修改意见当成个人否定会拖慢节奏。把反馈当作打磨作品的数据，而不是对你价值的宣判。

health.en: Emotional moodiness or escapist scrolling may be masking simple tiredness; soothe yourself with real rest and quiet offline time.
health.zh: 情绪起伏或靠刷屏逃避现实，往往只是单纯累了；用真正高质量的休息和安静的离线时光来安抚自己。

spirituality.en: Doubting your intuition—or mistaking wishful anxiety for a sign—clouds perception; return to calm, grounded breathing.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，过度怀疑直觉或把焦虑臆测当成神秘讯号都会搅浑感知；回到平稳呼吸与踏实当下，清澈感自会归来。

promptSpec.suitAccent: luminous cerulean-sapphire, moonstone amethyst, shimmering pearl water highlights, gleaming gilded chalice, moonlit ivory
promptSpec.scene: Standing gracefully along a tranquil moonlit coastal shore with gentle pearl-crested sapphire waves curling behind them, ONE youthful Belle Epoque Page in a flowing cerulean-and-ivory silk tunic embroidered with golden water lilies and a soft velvet beret looks with bright, delighted curiosity at the cup in their hand. Held steadily at chest height in the Page's right hand is EXACTLY ONE gleaming, ornate antique-gold chalice, from whose rim ONE small iridescent silver-blue fish peeks playfully upward toward the Page's smiling face. Luminous moonlight and warm antique-gold specular highlights illuminate the Page's face, graceful fingers, the single golden chalice, and the peeking fish against a starry deep midnight-indigo sky.

requiredObjects.object: ornate golden chalice held by Page
small iridescent silver-blue fish peeking upward
youthful Page standing by the sea

promptSpec.compositionNote: Clean three-quarter portrait silhouette against calm moonlit sea: the Page's delighted gaze locks onto ONE bright golden chalice with the peeking silver-blue fish at center-right—reads instantly at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Devoted idealism in motion—bearing beauty, romance, and heartfelt purpose forward with grace.
archetypeEssence.zh: 奔赴理想的浪漫行动者——带着深情、美感与赤诚邀约优雅前行。

en: Armored Knight riding a calm white horse at a measured, graceful pace
Winged helmet and winged boots symbolizing elevated imagination and poetic messenger energy
Single gleaming golden cup held steadily forward like a cherished offering
Winding river crossing a quiet landscape toward distant hills of aspiration
zh: 身披铠甲、骑乘沉稳白马从容缓行的骑士
带翼头盔与翼靴，象征高飞的想象力与诗意信使
向前稳稳托举的单只金色圣杯，宛如郑重递出的邀约
蜿蜒穿过旷野流向远山的河流，映照追寻理想的旅程

en: Poetic Belle Epoque Knight in engraved silver-and-sapphire armor with delicate gilded wings on the helm, riding a luminous pale ivory horse beside a moonlit river
Exactly one gleaming ornate antique-gold chalice held steadily forward in the Knight's right hand as a graceful offering
Flowing cerulean-and-amethyst surcoat embroidered with shimmering golden fish and wave motifs
Moonlit silver water reflections and distant indigo peaks framing the composed equestrian silhouette
zh: 身着雕花银蓝铠甲、头盔饰有精致鎏金双翼的美好年代骑士，骑乘月白骏马沿河缓行
骑士右手平稳向前托举的一只古金雕花圣杯，宛如郑重奉上的心意
随风轻扬、绣有金鱼与波纹图案的蓝宝石与紫晶战袍
微光河流倒影与远方靛蓝山影衬托出优雅从容的骑行剪影

core.en: Knight of Cups moves toward what moves the heart: a romantic overture, a creative quest, or a diplomatic invitation carried with grace and sincerity. Follow beauty and conviction—just keep your eyes on the road as well as the horizon.
core.zh: 圣杯骑士朝着令内心震颤的方向优雅前行：一份浪漫邀约、一场创意奔赴，或带着诚意与风度的主动靠近。追随美感与热爱，同时别忘了看清脚下真实的路。

message.en: Lead with genuine charm, artistry, and heart—a heartfelt invitation or creative pursuit is ready to move forward.
message.zh: 带着真诚风度、美感与热忱主动迈步——一份发自内心的邀约或创意追求正适合向前推进。

foundation.en: A romantic ideal, artistic vision, or sincere desire to win someone's trust set this movement in motion.
foundation.zh: 一份浪漫理想、艺术愿景或赢得对方信赖的真挚愿望，推动了眼前的行动。

present.en: Warmth, diplomacy, and creative momentum are flowing; an inviting offer or inspiring pursuit is drawing closer.
present.zh: 柔情、外交风度与创意动能正在流动；一份令人心动的邀约或灵感奔赴正朝你靠近。

challenge.en: Chasing an ideal vision may be glossing over practical timelines or mundane details; check what the romance of the plan is skipping.
challenge.zh: 全心追逐理想愿景时，现实的排期和琐碎细节可能正被一笔带过；看看这份浪漫的计划略过了什么。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is magnetic sincerity—combining aesthetic taste with real empathy wins allies effortlessly.
resource.zh: 你最具感染力的优势是真诚与好品味兼具——用共情与美感打动人心，往往事半功倍。

action.en: Make the graceful move—extend the invitation, pitch the creative vision, or show up with unmistakable sincerity and care.
action.zh: 优雅而大方地迈出这一步——发出那份邀约、呈现你的创意愿景，或带着清晰的诚意主动赴约。

outcome.en: This tends toward a charming offer, a deepening romance, or an inspiring creative breakthrough, likely to come with memorable grace.
outcome.zh: 事情多半会走向一份迷人的邀约、升温的感情或令人欣喜的创意突破，并且很可能带着令人难忘的优雅。

advice.en: Keep the horse's pace steady—devotion carried with patience and follow-through outlasts grand gestures alone.
advice.zh: 稳住坐骑的步伐——配合耐心与实际兑现的深情，远比昙花一现的宏大姿态更长久。

hidden.en: An offer or approach may be on its way that nobody has told you about yet. Check, too, whether you are more moved by this than you have admitted; your heart may have already picked a direction.
hidden.zh: 一份提议或一次主动靠近，也许已经在路上，只是还没人告诉你。也看看你是不是比承认的更动心——你的心可能已经选好了方向。

self.en: You are the one who makes the approach: warm, courteous, guided by what you find beautiful or meaningful. You bring sincerity and a readiness to offer your feelings openly.
self.zh: 你是主动走过去的那个人：温暖、有礼，跟着自己觉得美或有意义的东西走。你带来的是诚意，以及把心意坦然递出去的准备。

other.en: The other person appears to be courting your interest: attentive, charming, coming toward you with an offer or an invitation. Their manner looks sincere, and time will show how well the follow-through matches the approach.
other.zh: 对方看起来正在争取你的好感：殷勤、有魅力，带着一份提议或邀约朝你走来。对方的态度看着是真诚的，至于后续行动跟不跟得上，要靠时间来看。

external.en: Invitations and proposals are in the air: someone is making an approach, an offer is being carried toward you, and the climate favors courtesy and good taste. Events move at a measured pace, not a rush.
external.zh: 邀约和提议正在酝酿：有人在主动靠近，一份邀请正朝你送来，大环境也偏爱礼貌与品味。事情是不紧不慢地推进的，不是一阵猛冲。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to be swept toward something beautiful—a love, a calling, a cause worth your devotion—yet fear that the feeling is all there is and that it will not survive ordinary life.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着被带向某种美好的东西——一段爱、一份志业、一件值得倾心的事；又怕这里只有感觉，一碰上平常日子就撑不下去。

general.en: Heartfelt pursuit, creative grace, and sincere invitations move this chapter forward. Follow what genuinely inspires you while keeping your promises grounded in action.
general.zh: 真诚奔赴、创意风度与动人邀约正推动这一阶段向前。追随真正打动你的人与事，同时用踏实兑现托住这份浪漫。

love.en: In love, Knight of Cups is classic romance, thoughtful courtship, and emotional devotion. Express affection with warmth and imagination, backed by steady presence.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯骑士代表经典浪漫、用心的追求与深情投入。用温暖与想象力表达爱意，并以稳定陪伴让它真正落地。

career.en: At work, this favors creative pitches, diplomacy, client charm, and missions you genuinely care about. Pair your inspiring vision with a clear execution plan.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，这张牌利于创意提案、外交斡旋、赢得客户好感以及投身真正热爱的使命。给动人的愿景配上一份清晰的落地计划。

health.en: For wellbeing, beauty and emotional uplift matter—gentle expressive movement, soothing surroundings, and pacing yourself calmly restore harmony.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，美感与好心情同样是良药——温和舒展的运动、赏心悦目的环境与不急不躁的节奏，能让你恢复和谐。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Knight of Cups is devotion in action: treating everyday craft, kindness, and beauty as a living pilgrimage.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，圣杯骑士代表行动中的虔敬：把日常里的善意、美感与专注，都当作一场活生生的内在旅程。

core.en: Knight of Cups reversed warns of moody idealism: sweeping promises without follow-through, falling in love with the chase, or letting shifting feelings steer the wheel.
core.zh: 圣杯骑士逆位警惕情绪化的浪漫主义：空有动听承诺却缺乏兑现、只沉迷追逐感，或任由起伏不定的心情左右方向。

blocked.en: Waiting for the perfect mood or cinematic moment before taking real action.
blocked.zh: 总在等完美的情绪或戏剧化时机，迟迟不肯落地行动。

excess.en: Over-romanticizing, dramatic mood swings, or charming words that outrun real commitment.
excess.zh: 过度滤镜化、情绪大起大落，或动人辞藻远远跑在实际承诺前面。

internalized.en: Quiet disillusionment when reality fails to match an impossibly polished fantasy.
internalized.zh: 当现实达不到完美幻想时，心底悄然涌上的失落与意兴阑珊。

release.en: Grounding romance and creativity in steady, reliable deeds rather than fleeting highs.
release.zh: 把浪漫与创意从短暂激情里拉回地面，用稳定可靠的行动来承接。

message.en: Judge this by what gets done, not by how good it sounds. A feeling that changes every week is a poor guide for a lasting decision.
message.zh: 看这件事，要看做成了什么，而不是听上去有多好。一份每周都在变的心情，不适合拿来指导长久的决定。

foundation.en: A beautiful beginning that was never backed up—big words, a rush of feeling, then a fade—is the root here. Somebody fell for the idea of this before finding out what it would take.
foundation.zh: 一个很美、却没有后续支撑的开头——豪言、一阵汹涌的心动，然后慢慢淡去——是这件事的根。有人在弄清它需要付出什么之前，就先爱上了这个念头。

present.en: Enthusiasm is running hot and cold: plans announced and then dropped, affection that depends on the mood of the day. The charm is still there, but nothing is being carried through to the end.
present.zh: 眼下的热情忽冷忽热：计划刚宣布就搁下，亲近与否全看当天的心情。魅力还在，但没有哪件事被真正做到底。

challenge.en: Unrealistic expectations or inconsistent follow-through is eroding trust faster than charm can repair it.
challenge.zh: 不切实际的期待或时冷时热的兑现度，正比风度修补得更快地消耗信任。

resource.en: The capacity to feel deeply and imagine something better is real and worth keeping. Disappointment has also taught you the difference between a promise and a plan, which makes you harder to dazzle.
resource.zh: 深深去感受、去想象更好事物的能力是真的，也值得留着。失望还让你看清了“许诺”和“计划”的区别，你因此不那么容易被迷住了。

action.en: Check actions against words—keep one small concrete promise this week instead of offering another grand speech.
action.zh: 拿行动对照承诺——这周踏实兑现一件具体小事，胜过再说一番动听宣言。

outcome.en: Sobering up from fleeting highs tends to restore credibility and helps separate genuine devotion from empty theater.
outcome.zh: 从短暂激情中清醒过来，往往能慢慢赢回信赖，也有助于分清什么是真心，什么是表演。

advice.en: Let reliability be your new romance—consistency speaks louder than poetry when trust is on the line.
advice.zh: 把可靠当成新的浪漫——当信任面临考验时，稳定兑现比任何诗意都更有说服力。

hidden.en: Ask whether it is the person or goal you want, or the thrill of pursuing it. A quiet disappointment that reality is plainer than the fantasy may be cooling things without being mentioned.
hidden.zh: 问一问你想要的是那个人、那个目标本身，还是追逐带来的刺激。一份“现实比幻想平淡”的暗暗失望，也许正在不声不响地让事情降温。

self.en: You are in love with how this could be and less interested in the daily work of making it so. Your mood decides how much you give, so others may find you less dependable than you mean to be.
self.zh: 你爱上的是这件事“可以是”的样子，对把它一天天做出来的功夫却兴趣不大。你给多少全由心情决定，所以在旁人眼里，你可能没有自己以为的那么靠得住。

other.en: The other party may be all approach and little arrival: flattering, intense for a while, then vague or absent. Their words appear to run ahead of their actions, so watch what they do over several weeks.
other.zh: 对方可能是“来势很足、落地很少”：会说好话，热烈一阵，随后变得含糊，或干脆不见人影。对方的话看起来跑在了行动前面，所以多观察几周，看实际做了什么。

external.en: Offers around you sound better than they are: proposals that stall, invitations withdrawn, people whose interest comes and goes. The climate favors romance and big talk over delivery, so outside promises need confirming.
external.zh: 你周围的提议听起来比实际要好：方案推不动，邀约被收回，人们的兴趣来了又走。大环境偏爱浪漫和大话，不重兑现，所以外面的许诺都需要确认。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the grand feeling will turn out to be solid after all, yet fear that asking for consistency will make the romance evaporate—or that you are the one who cannot stay.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着那份盛大的感觉到头来是靠得住的；又怕一旦要求始终如一，浪漫就蒸发了——或者发现留不下来的那个人，其实是你自己。

general.en: Watch for mood-driven decisions, charming half-promises, or chasing an unrealistic ideal. Ground your enthusiasm in clear facts and steady follow-through.
general.zh: 圣杯骑士逆位提醒警惕被情绪牵着走、华而不实的半吊子承诺，或追逐脱离现实的完美幻想。用清晰事实与稳定兑现托住热情。

love.en: In love, reversed Knight of Cups flags hot-and-cold affection, love-bombing, or projecting a storybook script onto a real partner. Trust consistent behavior over sweet talk.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯骑士逆位常对应忽冷忽热、前期过度殷勤或把童话剧本强加给现实伴侣。看长期稳定的行动，别只听甜言蜜语。

career.en: At work, inspiring pitches need operational backbone—avoid overpromising to impress, and double-check glamorous offers that lack concrete terms.
career.zh: 在工作上，漂亮的创意提案需要扎实的执行骨架——避免为了讨好而过度许诺，对缺少具体条款的光鲜邀约也要多核实。

health.en: Emotional highs and lows can throw off sleep and energy; anchor your week with steady, unglamorous routines that do not depend on your mood.
health.zh: 情绪大起大落容易打乱睡眠与状态；用不依赖心情好坏的朴素日常节奏，替自己稳住身心底盘。

spirituality.en: Notice where chasing emotional peak experiences is replacing quiet daily integrity; true devotion stays steady on ordinary Tuesdays.
spirituality.zh: 觉察追逐强烈情绪高峰体验是否取代了平实修习；真正的虔诚体现在平凡日子里的稳定如一。

archetypeEssence.en: Deep empathic wisdom and calm intuition—holding space for feeling without drowning in it.
archetypeEssence.zh: 深邃而沉静的共情智慧——安稳承接万千情绪，却不被浪潮淹没。

双手轻柔专注捧起的一只带盖古金雕花圣杯，杯柄化作精致金翼
与脚畔微光水波呼应的蓝宝石、月白与紫晶丝绸长裙

core.en: Queen of Cups embodies mature emotional intelligence: listening deeply, trusting your quiet inner knowing, and offering genuine compassion while keeping the lid on your own sacred vessel.
core.zh: 圣杯王后象征成熟深邃的情绪智慧：沉静倾听、信赖心底清澈的直觉，既能给出真挚温柔的共情，也懂得护住自己内心的神圣容器。

message.en: Trust what your intuition has already sensed—meet this situation with calm empathy rather than sharp force.
message.zh: 相信直觉早已感知到的真相——此刻用沉静温柔的共情去承接，远比强硬对抗更有效。

foundation.en: Deep care, emotional sensitivity, or someone's quiet devotion created the safe ground beneath this situation.
foundation.zh: 深沉的体贴、细腻的感知力或某人安静持久的守护，为眼下局面铺好了温柔底色。

present.en: Your intuitive clarity and emotional warmth are strong right now; people naturally feel safe opening up around you.
present.zh: 你此刻的直觉清明度与情绪温度都很饱满；身边人很容易在你面前卸下防备、坦露心声。

challenge.en: Absorbing everyone else's feelings may be leaving too little quiet for your own; notice whose emotions you are carrying right now.
challenge.zh: 替太多人承接情绪，可能正挤占你留给自己的那份安静；留意此刻你心里装着的究竟是谁的情绪。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is attuned listening—reading the unspoken room lets you respond with rare grace and timing.
resource.zh: 你最难得的优势是敏锐的共情倾听——读懂言外之意，让你总能拿捏出恰到好处的回应。

action.en: Listen without rushing to fix, trust your first quiet gut impression, and lead with steady kindness.
action.zh: 先安静倾听而不急着替人解决，相信心底第一时间的澄澈直觉，用沉稳善意化解僵局。

outcome.en: This tends toward emotional healing, deeper trust, and a serene inner alignment, settling like calm water after a breeze.
outcome.zh: 事情多半会走向情绪上的疗愈、更深的信任与沉静的内在笃定，像微风过后渐渐平复的水面。

advice.en: Keep your feet on dry stone even while sitting by the tide—compassion works best with clean boundaries.
advice.zh: 即便坐在海浪边，双脚也要稳稳踩在干爽石阶上——带着清晰边界的慈悲，才能走得最远。

hidden.en: Your intuition may already know something your reasoning has not caught up with. Look again at the quiet impression you keep setting aside, and check whether someone here is carrying more feeling than they show.
hidden.zh: 你的直觉也许已经知道了一些理智还没跟上的事。再看一眼那个被你一再搁到一边的安静印象，也留意这里是否有人感受到的比表现出来的多。

self.en: You show up as the listener: calm, receptive, tuned to what is not being said. You bring patience and real tenderness, and you tend to keep your own deepest feelings covered, like the lidded cup.
self.zh: 你在这件事里是倾听的那个人：平静、肯接纳，听得见没说出口的话。你带来耐心和真切的温柔，也习惯把自己最深的感受盖起来，像那只带盖的杯子。

other.en: The other person appears caring and attentive: listening closely, responding gently, slow to judge. They may reveal little of themselves, so expect kindness before disclosure.
other.zh: 对方看起来体贴而专注：听得仔细，回应得温和，不急着下判断。对方可能很少谈自己，所以你会先得到善意，之后才是坦露。

external.en: The emotional climate around you is gentle and supportive: people are willing to listen, a nurturing figure may be nearby, and feelings can be spoken safely. The setting rewards patience and tact over pressure.
external.zh: 你周围的情绪气候温和而支持：人们愿意倾听，身边可能有一位懂得照顾人的人，感受可以安全地说出来。这个环境偏爱耐心与分寸，而不是施压。

hopes_fears.en: Your hope is to be understood as deeply as you understand others; your fear is that lifting the lid on your own feelings would let out more than you, or anyone, could hold.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望被人理解得像你理解别人那样深，却也担心一旦掀开自己感受的盖子，涌出来的东西会多到你，或任何人，都接不住。

general.en: Intuitive clarity, deep compassion, and calm emotional presence guide you best. Trust your quiet inner knowing and respond with warmth rather than defensiveness.
general.zh: 清澈的直觉、深沉的慈悲与沉稳的情绪临在感此刻最能指引你。信赖心底安静的笃定，用温和而非防备去回应眼前的局面。

love.en: In love, Queen of Cups brings tender devotion, emotional safety, and effortless attunement. Listening with an open, non-judgmental heart deepens intimacy naturally.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯王后带来温柔深情、踏实的安全感与心照不宣的默契。不带评判地敞开倾听，亲密感会自然流向更深处。

career.en: At work, emotional intelligence, mentoring, counseling, and creative intuition shine. Read the human dynamics in the room and guide people with calm steadiness.
career.zh: 在工作上，高情商、辅导支持、团队凝聚与创意直觉正大放异彩。读懂场内的人心流动，用沉静笃定的方式带动协作。

health.en: For wellbeing, honor your sensitivity—hydration, soothing water rituals, quiet rest, and protecting your nervous system from harsh noise keep you balanced.
health.zh: 在身心养护上，尊重自己细腻的感受力——温和补水、舒缓放松、充足睡眠以及远离尖锐噪音，最能维持内在平衡。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Queen of Cups is still water reflecting the moon: quiet contemplation reveals far more than forcing answers.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，圣杯王后如映月静水：安住于沉静观照之中，答案会比用力追寻更清晰地自然浮现。

core.en: Queen of Cups reversed signals emotional overwhelm or porous boundaries: soaking up other people's storms until you feel drained, moody, or tempted to martyr yourself.
core.zh: 圣杯王后逆位提示情绪过载或边界过软：把旁人的风雨全揽进自己怀里，直到疲惫委屈、心绪翻涌，甚至陷入自我牺牲的消耗。

blocked.en: Shutting down your intuition or numbing out because feeling everything felt too heavy.
blocked.zh: 因为感受太沉重而索性关掉直觉与感受力，用麻木来硬撑。

excess.en: Over-empathizing, people-pleasing, or rescuing others at the expense of your own peace.
excess.zh: 过度共情、习惯性讨好或替别人兜底，耗干了自己的安宁。

internalized.en: Quietly carrying unspoken hurt while continuing to play the caretaker for everyone else.
internalized.zh: 自己心里已经满是委屈，表面却仍在继续扮演照顾所有人的角色。

release.en: Closing the lid on your chalice—reclaiming healthy emotional boundaries and self-care.
release.zh: 重新盖好圣杯的盖子——收回清晰的情绪边界，把温柔先还给自己。

message.en: Not every feeling in the room is yours to carry. Put down what belongs to other people and attend to your own heart first.
message.zh: 屋子里的情绪，并不是每一份都该由你来背。把属于别人的放下，先照看好自己的心。

foundation.en: A long role as the one who soothes, absorbs, and understands everybody is the root here. Somewhere back then you learned that being needed was the way to be loved, and your own needs went unspoken.
foundation.zh: 长久以来充当那个安抚所有人、吸收一切、理解每个人的角色，是这件事的根。在过去某个时候，你学会了“被需要才会被爱”，自己的需要也就一直没说出口。

present.en: You are emotionally waterlogged: tired, moody, tearful, or numb after taking in too much of other people's trouble. It is hard to tell right now which feelings are yours and which you picked up.
present.zh: 你现在像一块吸饱了水的海绵：吸收了太多别人的烦恼之后，疲惫、易波动、想哭，或是发麻。此刻很难分清哪些感受是自己的，哪些是从别人那里沾来的。

challenge.en: Porous boundaries are letting someone else's anxiety flood your own calm center.
challenge.zh: 过于柔软的边界，正让别人的焦虑顺着情绪通道淹没你原本平静的内心。

resource.en: The depth of feeling that floods you becomes a gift once it has a rim. You now know exactly where you leak, and the relief of closing the lid, even for one evening, is available right away.
resource.zh: 把你淹没的那份感受的深度，一旦有了杯沿，就是你的天赋。你已经清楚自己是从哪里漏的，而盖上盖子带来的松快，哪怕只有一个晚上，马上就能拥有。

action.en: Step back from caretaker mode today—say a gentle no, unplug from emotional noise, and tend your own heart first.
action.zh: 今天就从“照顾所有人”的模式里退一步——温和说一次不、隔绝情绪噪音，先把自己的心照顾好。

outcome.en: Restoring clear emotional boundaries tends to bring relief, and your natural intuition is likely to clear like settling water.
outcome.zh: 重新立住清晰的情绪边界，往往能带来松弛，你原有的直觉也多半会像沉淀后的水一样恢复清澈。

advice.en: Empathy without boundaries is just exhaustion; you can care deeply without carrying what is not yours.
advice.zh: 没有边界的共情只会变成内耗；你可以真心在乎一个人，但无需替对方扛起本属于他的课题。

hidden.en: Look for hurt you have been swallowing while looking after everyone else, and for resentment growing under the kindness. Caring may also be serving as a way to avoid your own unanswered questions.
hidden.zh: 找一找你在照顾所有人的同时，自己咽下了多少委屈，以及体贴底下是不是正长出怨气。照顾别人，也可能成了你回避自己那些没答案的问题的一种方式。

self.en: You are the caretaker running on empty: still saying 'I'm fine', still available, privately close to tears or shutdown. You treat your own feelings as the one thing that can wait.
self.zh: 你是那个已经见底、却还在照顾人的角色：嘴上仍说“我没事”，仍然随叫随到，私下却快要哭出来，或快要撑不住了。你把自己的感受当成唯一可以往后放的东西。

other.en: The other person may be leaning on you heavily, or swinging between moods in a way that pulls everyone in. They appear overwhelmed rather than calculating, though the effect on you is draining either way.
other.zh: 对方可能正重重地靠在你身上，或情绪起伏不定，把周围的人都卷进去。对方看起来是不堪重负，而不是在算计，但无论哪种，对你都是消耗。

external.en: The emotional weather around you is heavy: other people's crises, a tense household or workplace, constant requests for comfort. Much of the distress in the air starts elsewhere and is not yours to resolve.
external.zh: 你周围的情绪天气很沉：别人的危机、紧绷的家或职场，还有不断找上门来求安慰的人。空气里的这些苦恼，大多源自别处，也不该由你来解决。

hopes_fears.en: You hope that someone will look after you the way you look after them, yet fear that setting a limit will make you seem cold and cost you the love you earn by giving.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着有人能像你照顾别人那样照顾你；又怕一旦设下界限，自己就显得冷漠，把靠付出换来的爱也赔进去。

general.en: Emotional fatigue or blurred boundaries need gentle repair. Step back from absorbing other people's moods and give your own sensitivity quiet shelter.
general.zh: 圣杯王后逆位提醒你及时修补情绪透支与模糊边界。别再替旁人消化情绪风暴，给细腻敏感的自己留出一处安静避风港。

love.en: In love, reversed Queen of Cups flags codependency, silent martyrdom, or expecting a partner to intuit your hurt. Speak your needs plainly instead of suffering quietly.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯王后逆位提示过度依附、默默委屈或指望对方猜中你的心事。把需求温和而直白地说出来，别再独自暗自伤神。

career.en: At work, taking on teammates' stress or avoiding firm limits leads straight to burnout. Separate kind professionalism from emotional over-responsibility.
career.zh: 在职场上，替同事扛情绪或不好意思拒绝额外负担会迅速引发耗竭。分清温和专业与过度兜底，守住清晰职责边界。

health.en: Emotional overload is likely draining your sleep and nervous system; prioritize solitude, gentle rest, and decompressing away from demands.
health.zh: 情绪过载正直接消耗你的睡眠与神经能量；把独处、温和休养和远离外界索取当作当下最优先的调理。

spirituality.en: Ground your sensitivity before trying to read the room—quiet self-compassion restores the clarity that overwhelm muddied.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，在急着感知外界情绪之前请先稳住自己的重心——对自己的温柔接纳，能迅速洗清过载带来的迷雾。

promptSpec.compositionNote: Graceful seated profile silhouette beside calm moonlit waves, her gentle gaze focused directly on ONE brightly lit lidded golden chalice held in both hands—reads unmistakably at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Sovereign emotional steadiness—commanding calm counsel and compassion even atop turbulent waters.
archetypeEssence.zh: 沉稳笃定的情感定力——纵使身处起伏浪潮之上，依然从容宽厚、进退有度。

en: Composed King seated on a heavy stone throne resting steadily amid rolling sea waves
Single golden chalice held calmly in his right hand and short golden scepter in his left
Fish amulet pendant resting on his chest symbolizing mastery over intuitive depths
Leaping fish and distant sailing ship on the choppy horizon showing poise amid motion
zh: 端坐于翻涌海浪之上雕花石座、神态沉稳的国王
右手从容持握的一只金色圣杯，左手轻握短金杖
垂于胸前的鱼形吊坠，象征对潜意识深海的驾驭
海面跃起的鱼影与远方航船，映照风浪中的定力

en: Dignified, composed Belle Epoque King seated squarely on a carved stone throne resting steadily atop rolling moonlit sapphire waves
Exactly one gleaming ornate antique-gold chalice held calmly in his right hand, paired with a slender short golden scepter in his left hand
Rich cerulean-sapphire velvet robes lined with warm antique gold and a small gilded fish pendant gleaming at his chest
One leaping silver fish and a small distant ship cresting luminous pearl-tipped waves under a deep starry midnight sky
zh: 端坐于翻涌月色蓝海石座之上、气度沉稳的美好年代国王
右手稳稳持握的一只古金雕花圣杯，左手轻执纤细短金杖
滚有暖金镶边的深蓝宝石丝绒长袍，胸前垂挂一枚微光金鱼坠饰
远方珍珠浪花间跃起的银鱼与航船，在星夜蓝天下勾勒出大将风度

core.en: King of Cups represents emotional mastery under pressure: feeling deeply without being swept away, offering wise diplomatic counsel, and holding steady warmth when everyone else is rattled.
core.zh: 圣杯国王代表风浪之下的情绪定力：内心依然丰沛敏感，却不被浪头掀翻；能在众人慌乱时给出温和有分寸的判断与支撑。

message.en: Lead with calm emotional steadiness—diplomacy, patience, and composed empathy tend to carry the room.
message.zh: 用沉稳的情绪定力主导局面——外交风度、耐心与克制而真诚的共情，往往能稳住全场。

foundation.en: Mature judgment, hard-earned self-control, or a wise mentor's steady counsel grounded this situation.
foundation.zh: 成熟的阅历、练就的自控力，或一位通透长辈的稳妥指引，为眼下局面打下了定盘星。

present.en: Even if circumstances feel choppy, you have the composure to steer calmly without reacting from impulse.
present.zh: 即便外在局势略有起伏，你此刻具备足够定力稳舵前行，不会被一时冲动牵着走。

challenge.en: Staying perpetually composed may be making it hard for others to see what you personally need; notice where the steady role hides your own ask.
challenge.zh: 总是扮演沉稳的支柱，可能让旁人看不见你自己也有需要；留意这个稳重的角色替你藏起了哪些请求。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is balanced authority—combining genuine kindness with cool-headed perspective inspires deep trust.
resource.zh: 你最有分量的优势是刚柔并济的威信——把真挚善意与冷静大局观合二为一，极易赢得信赖。

action.en: Step into the steady mediator role—hear both sides calmly, keep your tone measured, and make a fair, humane call.
action.zh: 站出来担任沉稳的调和者——平静听取各方声音、保持克制语调，做出既公平又有人情味的决定。

outcome.en: Under steady, wise stewardship, the turbulence tends to settle, and lasting respect, emotional balance, and a trustworthy resolution become likely.
outcome.zh: 在稳妥的掌舵下，风波往往会渐渐平息，长久的尊重、情绪上的平衡与令人信服的解决也多半随之而来。

advice.en: Master the wave by staying centered rather than freezing the sea—true strength stays warm.
advice.zh: 驾驭风浪靠的是稳住重心，而不是把大海冻成冰块——真正的力量始终保有温度。

hidden.en: Strong feeling may be running under a calm surface here, yours or someone else's. Check what the composure is holding, and whether a steady figure in the background is quietly keeping things afloat.
hidden.zh: 平静的表面之下，可能正涌动着强烈的感受，是你的，或别人的。查看这份镇定底下压着什么，也留意是否有一位沉稳的人，正在幕后默默稳住局面。

self.en: You are the steady one here: feeling plenty, showing it in measured doses, keeping your head while others lose theirs. You bring tact, patience, and a habit of thinking before you react.
self.zh: 你在这件事里是稳住的那个人：感受很多，却有分寸地表露，在别人慌乱时保持清醒。你带来的是得体、耐心，以及先想清楚再反应的习惯。

other.en: The other party appears composed and considerate: even-tempered, diplomatic, hard to rattle. They are likely to offer support or sound advice while keeping their own feelings mostly to themselves.
other.zh: 对方看起来沉着而体贴：脾气平和、处事圆融、不容易被惊动。对方多半会给出支持或中肯的建议，自己的感受则大多留在心里。

external.en: Conditions are in motion—shifting moods, competing interests, choppy water—yet a calm, experienced presence is available: a mentor, a fair-minded authority, or a setting that values tact. Steady hands are respected here.
external.zh: 外部条件正在变动——情绪起伏、利益交错、水面不平——但有一股沉着而老练的力量可以依靠：一位导师、一个处事公道的主事者，或一个看重分寸的环境。稳得住的人在这里受到尊重。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to stay calm and kind however rough it gets, yet fear that one day the feelings you manage so well will break through and swamp you in front of everyone.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着无论局面多乱，自己都能保持平静与善意；又怕有一天，那些被你管得很好的情绪会冲破堤岸，当着所有人的面把你淹没。

general.en: Emotional balance, wise counsel, and diplomatic poise anchor this moment. Stay calm amid moving parts and let mature compassion guide your decisions.
general.zh: 情绪平衡、通透建言与从容外交风度正稳住这一刻。在变化起伏中守住内在定盘星，让成熟的慈悲与清醒共同指引决策。

love.en: In love, King of Cups offers loyal, protective tenderness and mature communication—holding space for a partner's feelings without losing his own grounded center.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯国王带来忠诚笃定的温柔与成熟沟通——既能稳稳接住伴侣的情绪起伏，也不会丢掉自己的沉着底色。

career.en: At work, this is diplomatic leadership, trusted advisory roles, and calm crisis management. People look to you for steady judgment when stakes run high.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，这张牌代表温和而有威信的领导力、值得托付的顾问角色与沉着应对危机的定力。越是关键时刻，旁人越信赖你的判断。

health.en: For wellbeing, steady emotional regulation protects physical resilience; calm pacing, measured stress habits, and wise professional counsel keep you centered.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，稳定的情绪调节直接护住体能底盘；张弛有度的节奏、平和减压方式与专业建议，让你始终保持从容。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, King of Cups unites heart and mind: deep compassion paired with quiet equanimity in the middle of an unpredictable world.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，圣杯国王实现了心与智的平衡：在变幻莫测的世事之中，依然怀抱深沉慈悲与不动声色的平和。

core.en: King of Cups reversed warns of emotional control slipping sideways: either bottling up feelings behind an icy mask, or using charm and guilt subtly to steer others.
core.zh: 圣杯国王逆位警示情绪掌控出现偏差：要么用冷漠克制的面具死死压抑真实感受，要么暗中借情绪、愧疚感或人情去左右他人。

blocked.en: Repressing vulnerability behind stoic composure until pressure leaks out as coldness or moodiness.
blocked.zh: 拿滴水不漏的镇定死死压住脆弱，直到压力以冷淡或暗涌的脾气漏出来。

excess.en: Subtle emotional manipulation, passive-aggression, or letting unchecked moods undermine authority.
excess.zh: 隐蔽的情绪操控、冷处理施压，或任由失控心绪削弱自身威信。

internalized.en: Privately feeling overwhelmed by responsibility while refusing to admit you are rattled.
internalized.zh: 内心其实已被重担压得翻涌不止，却死要面子不肯承认自己动摇了。

release.en: Dropping emotional games and stoic armor in favor of plain, accountable honesty.
release.zh: 放下情绪博弈与僵硬外壳，回到坦荡、负责任的直白沟通。

message.en: Being unreadable is not the same as being in control. Say directly what is going on with you before it comes out sideways.
message.zh: 让人看不透，并不等于掌控得住。把你心里正在发生的事直接说出来，别等它从别的地方漏出来。

foundation.en: A long habit of swallowing feelings to stay in charge, or of being managed by someone who did, set this up. Strong emotion was treated as weakness early on, so it learned to work through indirect routes.
foundation.zh: 为了稳住局面而长期把情绪咽下去的习惯，或是曾被一个这样做的人拿捏，为这件事铺了路。强烈的情绪很早就被当成软弱，于是它学会了绕着弯起作用。

present.en: The surface is controlled and the water underneath is not. Feelings are being suppressed or used as leverage: silences, guilt, a mood that others have to tiptoe around.
present.zh: 表面控制得很好，水下却不是这样。感受不是被按住，就是被拿来当筹码：沉默、让人愧疚的话，或一副让旁人不得不小心翼翼的脸色。

challenge.en: Bottled-up feelings or subtle emotional power plays are clouding trust beneath a polite surface.
challenge.zh: 憋在心底的压抑情绪或不动声色的情感博弈，正在礼貌表象下悄悄侵蚀信任。

resource.en: What sits behind the mask is real strength once it is owned openly. You also understand from experience how moods move people, knowledge that becomes trustworthy the moment it is used in plain view.
resource.zh: 面具后面的那些感受，一旦被坦然承认，就是真正的力量。你也凭经验懂得情绪如何影响人，这份了解只要摆到明面上使用，就立刻变得可信。

action.en: Drop the poker face or subtle pressure—state your real concern plainly and let others make a free, honest choice.
action.zh: 卸下故作镇定的面具或隐性施压——把真实顾虑坦荡说清，让对方自由而诚实地回应。

outcome.en: Naming repressed tension tends to clear the undercurrent, making room for genuine emotional integrity and calmer footing to return.
outcome.zh: 把压抑的暗流说开，水下的紧绷往往会随之消散，真诚的坦荡与更稳的立足点也有机会重新归位。

advice.en: Repression is not mastery—honest self-regulation lets feelings move through without steering from the shadows.
advice.zh: 压抑从来不是情绪掌控——真正的定力是允许感受诚实流过，而非躲在暗处暗中较劲。

hidden.en: Check whether pressure is being applied by indirect means, yours or another's: a favor that carries a debt, a silence meant to punish, calm that is really withdrawal. Something strongly felt may be going unsaid.
hidden.zh: 查一查有没有人在用间接的方式施压，是你，或是别人：一份带着人情债的帮忙、一段意在惩罚的沉默、一种实为抽离的平静。可能有一份强烈的感受，一直没有被说出来。

self.en: You are showing up armored: composed on the outside, churning within, unwilling to admit you are shaken. You may be steering by hints and moods instead of asking outright for what you need.
self.zh: 你披着铠甲走进这件事：外表镇定，内里翻腾，不肯承认自己被撼动了。你可能在用暗示和脸色带方向，而不是直接开口要你需要的东西。

other.en: The other person may be hard to read and harder to trust at the moment: cool, withholding, or pleasant in a way that leaves you feeling obliged. Notice whether their warmth appears mainly when they want something.
other.zh: 对方眼下可能很难看透，更难让人放心：冷淡、有所保留，或和气得让你觉得欠了什么。留意对方的热络，是不是主要出现在有所求的时候。

external.en: The atmosphere is tense under polite manners: an authority figure whose moods set the tone, unspoken rules, loyalty traded for favors. You did not create these undercurrents, but you do have to navigate them.
external.zh: 礼貌的举止底下，气氛是紧的：一位用自己的脸色定调的掌权者、不成文的规矩、拿人情换来的忠诚。这些暗流不是你造成的，但你确实得在其中行船。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes to keep everything contained and handle it alone; another part fears that if anyone sees how shaken you are, you will lose their respect—or your own.
hopes_fears.zh: 你一面盼着能把一切都兜住、独自处理好，一面又怕让人看见自己动摇得多厉害，就会失去别人的尊重——甚至自己对自己的尊重。

general.en: Check for emotional repression, passive-aggressive undertones, or feeling secretly tossed by waves you pretend not to notice. Honest transparency restores real steadiness.
general.zh: 圣杯国王逆位提醒你排查情绪压抑、暗自冷处理，或表面镇定内心却早已被风浪掀翻的状态。坦诚透明，才是找回真正定力的起点。

love.en: In love, reversed King of Cups flags emotional withdrawal, subtle guilt-tripping, or keeping a partner at arm's length to stay in control. Trade guardedness for honest warmth.
love.zh: 在感情中，圣杯国王逆位常对应冷漠抽离、隐蔽的情绪施压，或为了握住主导权而刻意保持距离。放下防备，用坦诚暖意修复信任。

career.en: At work, watch for office politics played through charm, moody leadership, or swallowing frustration until it snaps. Keep communication transparent and fair.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕借人情圆滑搞暗箱博弈、情绪化的管理风格，或长期憋着不满直到爆发。保持透明、公正且直接的沟通。

health.en: Swallowing stress behind a calm facade takes a quiet physical toll; find a safe, honest outlet to release pressure before tension hardens.
health.zh: 把所有压力吞进肚子里硬装镇定，正悄悄在身体上留下消耗；找一个安全坦诚的出口及时释放，别等紧绷积劳成疾。

spirituality.en: True equanimity never requires pretending you feel nothing; meet your own shadow with the same compassion you offer others.
spirituality.zh: 真正的平和从不需要假装无动于衷；用你对待旁人时的那份宽厚与理解，去诚实面对自己内心的暗涌。
